issues.description: The UML in the problem statement declares getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor() as returning int, but the template's TODO and the solution implementation expect/return a double. This mismatch can confuse students about which return type to implement and may cause incorrect implementations or failing tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent across artifacts. Update the UML and any problem-text references to declare getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor(): double (to match the template comment and solution), or alternatively change the template TODO and solution to return int. Prefer updating the UML/problem text to double for a more precise calculation as indicated in the template comment.
